description.value: Foxy Farm Market is a neighbourhood greengrocer on West 1st Street in North Vancouver's Lower Lonsdale area. It operates as a farm-style market focused on fresh produce, making it a useful provisioning stop for cyclists riding the North Shore. The market's compact urban location puts it within easy reach of the Lonsdale Quay SeaBus terminal.
